name: Account reputation respects rank-capped quests
contract: Quests that only reward reputation up to a rank stay available only while the character's standing is below their RequiredMaxRepValue. Argent Dawn quest 9223 (Superior Armaments of Battle - Honored Amongst the Dawn) requires Honored up to 20999; once another character of the account reaches Revered, the alt receives Revered at login, 9223 is no longer offered and the Revered tier quest 9225 is.

steps.label: Honored alt can take the Honored tier quest
Honored alt cannot take the Revered tier quest
Alt receives the account's Revered Argent Dawn
Honored tier quest stops once the shared standing is Revered
Revered tier quest opens with the shared standing
